rationale: First-order heater tau~150-210s, K~1.0-1.2, ambient~0.175. Feedforward uff=(target-0.175)/1.15 gives 0.283 at 0.5, matching measured E7 0.28->0.506 and E6 0.30->0.531. PI trims residual: Kp=0.9 gives loop gain ~1, closed-loop tau~85s without amplifying 0.01-0.02 noise; Ki=0.008 (Ti~112s) removes offset inside 300s settling. EMA Tf=12s + outlier de-weighting suppresses noise vs 0.025 half-band. Integration enabled only when |e|<0.15 and yf<0.70 plus saturation back-calculation to avoid heat-up windup from 0.3 errors, while limits [-0.18,+0.22] leave >0.16 authority to correct feedforward error. Output clamp [0,0.75] and yf>0.75 cutback plus 2.5s output smoothing keep far from 0.85/0.9 limits and minimize u^2 dither.

extra.machine_card: Heater, positive gain. u=0 decays to ambient ~0.15-0.20 (E3 0.66->0.18 in 480s). u=0.28 holds ~0.506 in-band (E7), u=0.30 holds ~0.531 just above band (E6), u=0.35 holds >0.55 still rising (E5), u=0.5 holds ~0.65 (E2). Local gain ~0.8-1.25 (0.02u ->0.025y between E6/E7; global (0.647-0.17)/0.5~0.95). Lag dominant: tau heating ~150s (E1 0.21->0.53 in 180s), cooling ~210s (E3), settle 300-450s, no instant jump. No dead-zone in 0.28-0.5; below 0.2 untested. Self-draining on its own. Noise ~0.01-0.02 RMS with 0.03-0.05 outliers, comparable to band half-width 0.025. Rate bound 0.006/unit/s. Keep steady duty ~0.27-0.29 for 0.5.
extra.predicted_behavior: From cold 0.2, u~0.55 then backs to ~0.37 at 0.4, reaches band in ~130-170s without overshoot, settles inside band by ~200-250s. From hot 0.7, u~0.1 cools to band in ~150s. Steady dither +/-0.005 in u, y filtered +/-0.006, >85% time in band after 300s, MAE ~0.008-0.012, steady duty ~0.27-0.30. No 0.85 exceedance, no override.
